content.short: Tonstarter is a TON launchpad for token sales, community fundraising, and early access to upcoming ecosystem projects.
content.description: Tonstarter is a launchpad built for projects raising funds and building communities inside the TON ecosystem. It gives teams a place to run token sales and early distribution campaigns, while users can browse upcoming launches, join IDO style offerings, and follow projects before they reach wider markets. The platform is positioned as a fundraising and discovery layer for TON native builders, which makes it more relevant to capital formation and early access than to routine trading or wallet management.
content.meta: Tonstarter helps TON projects raise funds and reach early supporters through launchpad listings, token sales, and community access.
